prompt: We sell missed-call recovery and booking software. Build an end-to-end GTM target list for healthcare clinics and medspas in the United States. First clarify the offer and ICP, then find ranked companies, identify the best Practice Administrator, Medical Director contacts, include intent or timing evidence where available, and return: company_name, domain, fit_score, fit_reason, contact_name, title, persona_fit_reason, linkedin_url, email_status, evidence_source, intent_signal, activation_recommendation, compliance_flags.
expected_output_schema: Create offer.md, icp.md, and a CSV-compatible lead list with contact-level rows.
